what: each of the four on-chain program binaries rebuilt from its source with its own recipe, run with the recipe's own path forms, target and output in a scratch directory

toolchain.platform-tools: v1.52 (offline copy kept with the author's tree)

earlier_attempt_that_differed.why: The compiler embeds source paths. With the cargo cache copied to a different location (and with a cache path of the same length) the registry sources are remapped to short relative paths; with the recipe's unnormalised path `<dir>/../solana-verifier-profile-v1/sbf-cargo-home` they appear in full. The pinned binary contains the full form. Keep the recipe's path forms to reproduce it.

limits: Reproduced on the author's machine with the author's offline toolchain and cargo caches, which are not published: a third party cannot repeat this from the public repository alone.
Bit-for-bit equality shows these sources and this recipe produce these binaries; it says nothing about whether the sources are correct.
